You are an expert chess player. You are given a chess board with FEN format. Your goal is to choose a better move given two candidate moves and their strategic explanation.
The FEN of the given chess board is "5r2/2Q5/4p2q/4P3/p2PB1k1/6P1/3NKP2/8 b - - 16 55". Which move is better? MoveA:f8f2 Surrender a piece to establish an open file or diagonal near the rival king MoveB:f8e8 Marshall the piece to a better square, extending its control over the board. 
Answer with exactly one of: MoveA:<move> or MoveB:<move>. Only output the line, nothing else.
